title: Audit the minimum stable always-on ROVOR Mac worker design
task: Design the smallest reliable persistent Mac user-session supervisor using a launchd LaunchAgent, SQLite at-most-once job claims, heartbeats, process logging, STOP, bounded task durations, and a secure GitHub or private queue transport. Discuss lock screen, GUI sessions, sleep, crashes, process reboot, and pending approvals. Explain how existing ROVOR Jane queue should plug in without rebuilding jobs or allowing FCPXML wrong-library import. Return an implementable 5-step sequence with deterministic tests. Do not claim Mac native GUI access. Flag assumptions.
deliverable: Concrete minimal architecture and failure-mode tests, not another entire rewrite proposal.
acceptance: Reuses current worker and GitHub task metadata instead of inventing duplicate queues
Separates always-on background tasks from unlocked GUI work
Provides safe at-most-once recovery for native GUI actions
No secret storage in GitHub or unattended shell commands
